introduction: Apple Health is Washington’s Medicaid coverage. The correct application system depends on the coverage category.
description: Apple Health is Washington’s Medicaid coverage. The correct application system depends on the coverage category.

sections.who: Income and household circumstances matter. Age, pregnancy, disability, Medicare and long-term-care needs can change the eligibility route.
sections.get: Approved coverage pays for eligible health services. Review assigned coverage and provider arrangements.
sections.docs:
• Household, income and identity details.
  • Insurance and category-specific evidence requested during intake.
sections.apply:
1. Choose the application route

    Adults, children, families and pregnant applicants generally use Washington Healthplanfinder.

  2. Use Classic Medicaid intake when applicable

    Aged, blind, disabled or Medicare-related applicants use Washington Connection; ask HCA about long-term services.

  3. Complete review

    Return requested evidence and check the coverage notice.
sections.after: Use the appropriate account for renewals and changes. Confirm providers with the assigned plan before arranging care.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using HCA coverage management; Aged, blind or disabled coverage. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
